Major update: New CLI tool for PKU's Blackboard Learn platform (course crate) with robust features and SSO login.

- Provides commands to list courses, browse content, manage assignments, and download materials (including videos and attachments).
- Authenticates via IAAA SSO and persists sessions locally.
- Uses HTML scraping (no API) and supports multipart file uploads for homework submission.
- All commands and outputs are in Chinese; robust error handling included.
- Supports auto-login for automation and AI agent integration.
- Credential management integrates with OS keyring and environment variables.
